Response examples copied from the Helius docs (helius.dev/docs, fetched 2026-10-24) and used by
test/parity.test.ts to assert field names/types. Placeholder strings ("PoolAddress...") are kept as in the docs.
- enhanced-transactions.json: api-reference/enhanced-transactions (POST /v0/transactions response)
- gtfa-signatures.json / gtfa-full.json: rpc/gettransactionsforaddress (response examples)
- priority-fee-all.json: api-reference/priority-fee (includeAllPriorityFeeLevels response)
- transaction-notification.json: rpc/websocket/transaction-subscribe (notification example, trimmed)
- webhook.json: api-reference/webhooks (webhook object)
